course.name: Build and Evaluate RAG
course.description: Retrieve evidence from a small corpus and test the answer against it.
course.longDescription: 35 minutes required. Prerequisites: Storage and Tables and Models and Profiles. Use a configured text embedding model and a configured chat model. Build separate index and question flows over supplied synthetic chunks, then test citations, source updates, no-answer and access cases. Model output and retrieval rankings must be inspected; the course does not promise exact wording or automatic verification.
